doc_class_description: A Sri Lanka Cabinet Decision is an official policy or action agreed by the Cabinet of Ministers, shaping governance, law, and national development in the country.

latest_doc_d.description: Submission of the Bill titled ‘Protection of the State from Terrorism’ to Parliament
latest_doc_d.decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-08-17 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
latest_doc_d.decision_details_body: - In view of the need to introduce a new law to cover the existing shortcomings of the Prevention of Terrorism (Temporary Provisions) Act, No. 48 of 1979, a Technical Expert Committee has been appointed to prepare a preliminary draft in relation to the said matter. Based on the preliminary draft prepared by the said Technical Expert Committee, policy approval has been granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2026-08-10 to introduce a new Act titled 'Protection of the State from Terrorism'. Accordingly, the clearance of the Attorney General has been received for the Bill prepared by the Legal Draftsman. The proposal made by the Minister of Justice and National Integration to publish the said Bill in the Government Gazette and thereafter submit it to Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.
